title: The Mount

services.name: Tours
services.desc: The Mount offers educational tours and experiences appropriate for public and private K-12 students, homeschoolers, youth organizations and summer camps, and colleges/universities. We work with educators and group organizers to curate programs that align with and enhance lesson plans and state frameworks across various disciplines. If you are interested in bringing your student group to The Mount, or would like more information, please fill out the form below. Below you will find an overview of The Mount’s educational offerings. We are happy to work with your organization to tailor your visit according to your group’s grade level and areas of interest. services.desc: Join Anne Schuyler, Director of Visitor Services, on a guided walk of The Mount’s gardens, woods, and meadows.
